sourceFindings.finding: Finite scalar support cost flood, one predecessor per cell, no heading/bend history; one surviving route per badge-endpoint.

pathLengthPx and efficiency recorded but absent from score product; local alignment is not total bend count or long-run reward. zfit searches a limited polyline family and rescales score, without replacing emitted raw paths.
max over orientation and full source-pixel width bank retains support and bestTheta, but discards winning width, runner-up edge pair, raw magnitude and bilateral-edge positions before routing.

All available badge×tee×basket triples scored; same endpoint route reused for every opposite endpoint. Greedy/local exchanges plus three starts are heuristic, not exact 3-way optimization. Positive evidence abstention is not automatic; alternatives output truncated to three.

Distinct ridge tracer emits UNKNOWN for ambiguous-fork/petered-out/etc.; bendCount counts contiguous turning phases rather than fitted physical bends. Arrival is basket footprint membership before checking support, not identity proof.

Existing prototype learns median full ribbon width from tee→badge cross profiles; uses raw luminance gradient edge pairs and per-course usable-segment count/IQR. Source has absolute width search 18..59 px; do not call it zoom-global or meter scale.
Existing paired-edge fit returns left/right/midpoint/width; bend search penalizes lateral midpoint offset. Prototype can supply centerline evidence without inventing a new intensity signal.
